name: icloud
description: Browse, verify, and safely archive files in the user's iCloud Drive through macOS.

interface.shortDescription: Safely work with files in iCloud Drive
interface.longDescription: A private macOS tool for browsing, verifying, and safely archiving files in the user's iCloud Drive. The plugin contains procedures only; the records themselves remain in iCloud Drive.
defaultPrompt: What is stored in this iCloud Drive folder?
Verify this file in iCloud Drive.
